FN-G3IYF2C-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 535
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Travis Hendrix
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/06/2026
House Bill 535 as introduced would provide for individuals whose records are expunged due to
being found not guilty or the conviction is overturned or vacated, pursuant to this bill to forgo
the payment of the existing $500 filing fee, which is distributed as follows:
AMOUNT FUND/AGENCY
$75 State Judicial Administrative Fund
$25 Department of Forensic Sciences
$50 District Attorney's Office
$50 Clerk's Office of Circuit Court
$50 Public Safety Fund
$50 County General Fund of arresting law enforcement agency
$100 State General Fund
$50 Education Trust Fund
$50 Fair Trial Tax Fund
Page 1

FN-G3IYF2C-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 535
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Travis Hendrix
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/11/2026
House Bill 535 as reported by the committee on Judiciary would provide for individuals to have
a boating violation expunged, pursuant to this bill.
This could increase receipts to the following funds below upon payment of the existing $500
filing fee, which is distributed as follows:
AMOUNT FUND/AGENCY
$75 State Judicial Administrative Fund
$25 Department of Forensic Sciences
$50 District Attorney's Office
$50 Clerk's Office of Circuit Court
$50 Public Safety Fund
$50 County General Fund of arresting law enforcement agency
$100 State General Fund
$50 Education Trust Fund
$50 Fair Trial Tax Fund
